<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<ValidationRule xmlns="http://soap.sforce.com/2006/04/metadata">
    <fullName>Outbound_Needs_Path</fullName>
    <active>true</active>
    <description>Enter the Path (for example /api/v1/voucher) before activating an outbound event.</description>
    <errorConditionFormula>AND(Active__c, ISPICKVAL(Direction__c, "Outbound"), ISBLANK(Path__c))</errorConditionFormula>
    <errorMessage>Enter the Path (for example /api/v1/voucher) before activating an outbound event.</errorMessage>
</ValidationRule>
